attackers_goals: Gain access to the host's filesystem. Gain root access to the host.
description: An identity created a Kubernetes Pod with a sensitive volume, allowing the Pod to have read or write permissions on the host's filesystem This could suggest an effort by an adversary to access sensitive files on the host and employ techniques for escalating privileges.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Inspect for any additional suspicious activities inside the Kubernetes Pod.
